title: Define group metadata cache (TTL-based, in-memory)
description:
Implement GroupMetadataCache: an in-memory cache of group name -> (count, low, high, description) with a configurable TTL (default 5 seconds). Cache is invalidated on any local write (POST or IHAVE). Backed by tokio::sync::RwLock<HashMap>. Artifact: reader/src/store/group_cache.rs.

Acceptance: cache returns stale data within TTL; cache is invalidated on write; concurrent reads do not deadlock; cache miss falls through to SQLite; unit test: insert article, verify cache invalidated
